exposure: Estimated blood loss (EBL) assessment methods (visual estimation by surgeon, evaluation of blood-soaked dressings, mathematical formula)
outcome: Early postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) defined as cumulative blood loss >=1000 mL
cohort: The study included women with a singleton pregnancy who underwent an elective or emergency cesarean section.
finding: In women with early PPH following a CS, dEBL and fEBL provided comparable estimations of blood loss, and emergency-mode CS and fetal macrosomia were identified as the strongest contributors to PPH.
mod_finding: An emergency mode of cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for early postpartum hemorrhage.
cross-section timing: Within the 24-hour period following delivery for the definition of early PPH.
birth_weight: PPH group: 3780 g; Control group: 3417.5 g; Fetal macrosomia was also a factor.
